overview: The council planned outreach strategies and logistics for several upcoming fall events, including the Harvest Your Energy Festival and Hispanic Heritage Month celebrations. The group also reviewed progress on the Main Streets small business energy program and the city's on-street electric vehicle charging grant.

items.title: Minutes and Scheduling
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting and scheduled the next meeting for September 17th.

items.title: Fall Community Events Calendar
items.summary: Coordinated staffing and energy coaching tables for several September events, including an ice cream social, the Mystic River Celebration, and Tufts Community Day.

items.title: Hispanic Heritage Month Planning
items.summary: Discussed hiring an edutainer and managing the budget for an interactive event at City Hall in October.

items.title: Harvest Your Energy Festival Logistics
items.summary: Reviewed plans for the October 18th festival, which will feature textile and electronic recycling, wind turbine tours, and a new transportation corner focused on cycling safety.

items.title: Event Outreach and Sustainability Improvements
items.summary: Brainstormed ways to reduce plastic waste at city events by using QR codes for information and providing sustainable giveaways like seed packets or BPA-free water bottles.

items.title: Electrify Medford and Main Streets Program Update
items.summary: Reported that 194 residents have signed up for energy coaching and announced a late October launch for a small business energy efficiency canvassing initiative.

items.title: High School HVAC and EV Charging Grant
items.summary: Noted that high school cooling repairs are behind schedule and identified four city parks as the proposed locations for a new on-street electric vehicle charging grant.

items.title: Climate Change Vulnerability Assessment
items.summary: Reviewed an updated interactive map that assesses the vulnerability of critical city assets like daycare centers and grocery stores to flooding and sea-level rise.
